The glossary is the one place to look up what a BDM term means: the
cross-cutting vocabulary (verbs, actor types, time terms, …) together with
every field the published schemas define (the trial tables, the event
envelope). Use it to check what a column name means before analyzing a
dataset, to find the term for a concept before inventing a new name, and to
see which schema owns a definition.

Filter by name or category below. Definitions are generated at build time
from the published [behaverse/schemas](https://behaverse.org/schemas)
artifacts—the [vocabulary](https://behaverse.org/schemas/vocabulary/terms.jsonld)
plus each schema's field definitions—so this page always matches the
schemas the site was built against; where a field name also exists as a
vocabulary term, the vocabulary definition is shown (it is canonical).
